Pulumi shipped ~9 releases in the window; 3.258.0 adds opt-in OS-protected credential encryption via `PULUMI_CREDENTIAL_STORE`, and 3.254.0 added `pulumi stack migrate` for backend migration.
Argo CD 3.5.0 (Aug 4) migrates from Helm 3 to Helm 4 — read the upgrade guide before touching HA installs.
Flux 2.9.4 (Aug 7) carries CRD schema changes for `ArtifactGenerator` and `ImageUpdateAutomation`, and disallows force-update via refspecs in image automation.
GitHub Actions now holds "potentially malicious" workflows for manual approval (Jul 28) and same-repo actions can be referenced with self-repository syntax (Jul 30).

Backstage 1.54.0 (Aug 19) tightens OAuth redirect-URI and CIMD allowlist matching, removes the deprecated `config.schema` extension option, and optimizes catalog relation sync to apply diffs instead of full rewrites.

Dagger 0.21.8 (Jul 29) computes changeset diffs from filesystem metadata instead of full-content comparison, and fixes Dockerfile layer caching so unrelated build-context edits stop invalidating the cache.
Prometheus 3.14.0 (Aug 17) enables duration expressions by default (`--enable-feature=promql-duration-expr` is now a no-op) and promotes `first_over_time` to stable.
OTel Semantic Conventions 1.44.0 (Aug 4) renames Kubernetes paging metrics (`k8s.pod.memory.paging.faults` → `k8s.pod.paging.faults`) and converts memory-usage metrics to updowncounter.

EKS added direct configuration of apiserver/scheduler/controller-manager flags through the EKS API (Aug 12) — the long-standing "you can't tune the managed control plane" gap.

GKE: TPU subslicing (Ironwood/TPU7x) GA, mixed TCP+UDP protocol LoadBalancer Services GA (1.36.2-gke.1498000+), NetworkPolicy on Dataplane V2 now scales to 15,000 nodes, and you can finally opt out of the default `kubernetes.io/arch=arm64:NoSchedule` taint via `--node-architecture-taint-behavior`.

AKS 2026-08-07: Node Auto Provisioning now works on private/VNet-integrated API server clusters, `availabilityZones=["auto"]` is globally enabled, node pool rollback went GA, and Azure Files encryption-in-transit is GA.

Serverless/compute: Lambda public-preview runtimes (Node.js 26, Python 3.15), CPU and memory metrics for Lambda MicroVMs for rightsizing, SQS provisioned mode for low-latency high-throughput processing, and GPU batch inference on ECS Managed Instances with scale-to-zero.
